scope: Documentation Site UX Overhaul: Scroll Snap Jumps, Category Routing, Responsive Function Viewer, Global Search Deep Links, and Workspace Cleanup

tasks.title: Home Page Folder Deck Scroll Snapping & Navigation Cleanup
tasks.description: On the Home Page ('/'), remove the top sub-tab bar and button navigation controls. Restructure sections into full-screen folder panels with snap-jump behavior: when a folder contains overflowing card content, native vertical scroll operates inside the folder until reaching the bottom edge (scrollTop + clientHeight >= scrollHeight - 2), at which point further downward scroll/wheel immediately triggers a clean snap-jump transition directly to the next folder section (and vice versa when scrolling up from the top edge).

tasks.title: Relocate Search and Category Title to API Slide Card Header
tasks.description: Inside the API Reference interface, move the category search/filter input directly into the top bar/header of the active Slide Card, alongside the active Category Name. Remove all method counters and approved method count badges (e.g., '18 Approved Methods', '23 Methods') from the slide card frame to prioritize presentation space for function details.

tasks.title: Mobile Horizontal Function Reel & Immediate Function Detail Focus
tasks.description: Fix mobile view (< 768px) inside the API Reference so scrolling through functions does not hide or obscure function details: (1) Render function tabs/chips in a compact horizontal scrolling ribbon above the slide card, (2) Keep the primary viewport dedicated exclusively to the active function's signature, parameter table, OpenXML impact notes, and code editor, and (3) Ensure parameter tables and code editors scroll horizontally inside the card without page layout reflow.

tasks.title: Fix Global Header Search Bar Redirection & Deep Linking
tasks.description: Fix the global header search input so selecting any matched search result immediately navigates to the exact target route (e.g., '/docs/api-reference/tables#addTable') and automatically scrolls to/activates that specific function or section slide card. Support direct URL hash anchors and query parameter sync on page load.

tasks.title: Generate Dedicated Dynamic/Static Pages for Each API Category
tasks.description: Restructure API Reference routes so every API category has its own dedicated URL path under '/docs/api-reference/[category]' (e.g., '/docs/api-reference/lifecycle', '/docs/api-reference/slides', '/docs/api-reference/text', '/docs/api-reference/tables', '/docs/api-reference/charts', '/docs/api-reference/shapes', '/docs/api-reference/images', '/docs/api-reference/elements'). Implement generateStaticParams() for static export, preserving deep links, sitemaps, and breadcrumbs.

tasks.title: Purge Orphaned, Redundant & Unused Files from docs-site
tasks.description: Audit the entire `docs-site/` directory tree and delete all unused legacy components, dead test fixtures, orphaned static images/assets, unreferenced CSS files, and outdated data schemas that are no longer utilized by the active Next.js App Router.
